desc: Derive a compact encoding of an LCS DP row: adjacent differences form an N-bit mask, and the LCS value is its popcount.
Implement and validate transitions from an encoded DP state after appending each lowercase character, using the standard LCS recurrence.
Precompute weighted transitions (next-mask multiplicities among 26 letters) for reachable/all masks.
Perform length-M DP over masks modulo 998244353.
Aggregate final mask counts by popcount and output answers for k=0..N.
